created_by_task: Model Benchmark Round 1 Design (design-only; 0 live calls)
purpose: Separate MODEL CAPABILITY from PROMPT EFFECTS by comparing candidate models under the EXACT current JobPilot semantic-matching contract. Prompt tuning is deferred to a later Prompt/Rubric Communication Ablation.
dataset_role_warning: Ground Truth has been inspected, baseline errors analysed, and failure slices designed from observed errors. Any improvement measured here is DEVELOPMENT-SET performance and MUST NOT later be presented as unbiased final test performance.

reference_baseline.reuse_policy: REUSE frozen result; do NOT spend 30 new live calls reproducing it. Rerun only if a fairness issue is identified and explicitly approved.

fixed_prompt.rule: Every candidate receives byte-identical semantic instructions. NO OR-list rule, adjacency guardrail, project-vs-work rule, or narrowest-subclaim rule is added to any candidate. Those belong to the deferred Prompt/Rubric Communication Ablation.

schema: fit-analysis-wire-v2 (FitAnalysisOutput{summary, requirement_matches[], suggested_preparation[]}; RequirementMatchOutput{requirement_id, importance, is_hard_requirement, hard_requirement_category, match_status in {Strong,Partial,Missing}, reason, confidence, evidence_source_ids[]})
normalization: production FitAnalysisService._normalize_matches (unchanged) — exact 1:1 requirement-id set, drop out-of-catalog evidence ids, downgrade cite-less Strong/Partial to Missing, whole-job reject on any id-set violation
match_score: production MatchScoreService (unchanged) — importance Critical 5 / Important 3 / Preferred 1; match Strong 1.0 / Partial 0.5 / Missing 0.0; round_half_up; matchable only

candidate_models.availability_source: backend/app/config.py Settings.claude_model + .env CLAUDE_MODEL + successful Baseline V1 run

candidate_models.candidate_status: availability_unverified — resolve via anthropic client.models.list() in execution Step 1; drop if no Opus-tier id is returned for this API key
candidate_models.availability_source: same anthropic SDK 0.125.0 + same ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; model id is a plain parameter to ClaudeStructuredClient — zero code change
candidate_models.note: Tests whether the Strong->Partial compression is model-capacity-bound at the SAME prompt.

candidate_models.model_identifier: RESOLVE_AT_EXECUTION (newest Sonnet build / Sonnet-5 if present)
candidate_models.candidate_status: availability_unverified — resolve via client.models.list(); include only if a distinct Sonnet id (not claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929) is available
candidate_models.note: Within-tier variation / newer build check; optional.

candidate_models.candidate_status: availability_unverified — resolve via client.models.list(); drop if no Haiku-tier id is returned
candidate_models.note: Screens whether a cheaper tier is 'good enough' under the same contract; expected to trade F1 for cost.

candidate_models.candidate_status: excluded_from_round1 — no openai SDK installed, no OPENAI_API_KEY in env or .env
candidate_models.note: Would require: pip install openai + credentials + an eval-only StructuredClient adapter (design in benchmark_round1_design.md §Cross-provider adapter). Deferred to a later round pending user approval.

candidate_models.candidate_status: excluded_from_round1 — no google-generativeai / vertex SDK installed, no GOOGLE/GEMINI credentials
candidate_models.note: Same as OpenAI: deferred, adapter design only.

round1_executable_candidate_count: 1 reference (reused) + 2 to 3 new Anthropic models = 3 to 4 total
primary_metric: Macro F1 on the 100 frozen matchable requirements (reconciled predictions)
co_primary_system_metric: Effective Correct Coverage = (correct AND successfully normalized) / 100
secondary_metrics: Model Match Score vs GT Match Score: MAE, median abs err, max err, jobs diff>=20, jobs diff>=30, Spearman
Model Match Score vs Human Match Fit: Spearman
latency (total wall, model total, mean, median, P90, min, max)
cost (only if pricing available locally; else COST_PENDING_EXTERNAL_PRICING_LOOKUP)

slices.or_list_rows: source_text contains 或 / 之一 / 等方向 / 等类产品 (is_or_list=true). n=18.
slices.technology_adjacency_rows: GT Missing rows where a specialised capability (multimodal / ASR / RL training / foundation-model / AIGC / streaming) is named and only general LLM/RAG/model-eval evidence exists. n~6-10.
slices.project_based_evidence_rows: GT or predicted reason references a project/internship (GoFin / KPay / 个人项目 / Product Owner) as main evidence.
slices.formal_work_experience_rows: source_text implies a formal professional role, or applies a duration qualifier to a matchable (not eligibility) requirement.
slices.compound_rows: is_compound=true (>=2 of: joint subclaim / >=2 dun-listed items / proficiency-completeness qualifier / multi-tool list). n=13.
slices.proficiency_depth_rows: source_text contains 熟练 / 精通 / 深入 / 扎实 / proficient / expert, or a multi-tool list requiring depth.
slices.domain_specific_rows: requirement names a specific industry/domain (证券 / 金融 / 医疗健康 / battery industry / 内容创作).
slices.mismatched_control_jobs: Dataset V1 role_category == mismatched_control (huawei:28183, xsolla:252b30e5, tencent:2064981110395420672).

per_slice_report: Macro F1 (only if slice n >= 12; else report counts only)

screening_criteria.note: Proposed thresholds are justified from Baseline V1 statistics; Round 1 is SCREENING not statistical certification (Dataset V1 n=100 rows / 30 jobs, single run, class-imbalanced 52/30/18).

hard_gates_all_must_pass.no_catastrophic_schema_pattern: job normalization success >= 28/30 AND no systematic id duplication/omission (>1 job lost = fail)

strong_partial_tradeoff_gate_all_must_pa.strong_precision: >= 0.80  (baseline 0.879; must not collapse to buy recall)

schema_reliability_preferred_not_gating.caveat: single-run zero-error does not prove reliability; repeat-run robustness is a later round

improvement_bar_vs_baseline_macro_f1_0.6.variance_caveat: no repeat runs in Round 1; treat a single +0.02..+0.05 as suggestive, not proven

run_policy.repeat_trials: NONE in Round 1 (deferred to a repeat-run robustness round)
run_policy.call_order: one candidate fully (30 jobs) then the next; persist raw response per job BEFORE any Ground Truth is loaded
run_policy.batching_change: forbidden — use the production one-semantic-call-per-job architecture

baseline_reuse_policy: Reference model claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 metrics come from job_match_baseline_claude_current_v1_*; NOT rerun. Rerun-all only if a fairness defect is found and approved.
cost_policy: No pricing present in repo config; web pricing lookup disallowed in design and in Round 1 execution. Report token usage per model. Mark cost = COST_PENDING_EXTERNAL_PRICING_LOOKUP for a later explicit pricing task.

model_inputs_may_contain: frozen candidate evidence snapshot (30 items, resume_extracted / manual_confirmed)
the unchanged production job-fit-v3 prompt + fit-analysis-wire-v2 schema
model_inputs_must_never_contain: OR-list / project-vs-work / adjacency human adjudication notes
GoFin C-end / AI-platform / Chinese-native manual facts
contamination_policy.ground_truth_load_timing: AFTER all 30 raw predictions for a candidate are persisted to disk

expected_live_calls_total.note: Design-only task made 0 calls. Execution is a separate, approval-gated task.

future_dataset_v2_policy: Dataset V1 is now development/model-selection data. A held-out Dataset V2 is required for unbiased validation, with more campus/new-grad roles, more company diversity (reduce Tencent+Baidu concentration from 87%), broader requirement-type distribution, and it must NOT be inspected before its use as a test set.
prompt_ablation_deferred: After Round 1 selects a model, a separate Prompt/Rubric Communication Ablation compares job-fit-v3 vs a rubric-aligned prompt (OR-list rule, adjacency guardrail, project-vs-work guidance, narrowest-unmet-subclaim) ON THE SELECTED MODEL ONLY.
planned_output_files: backend/evals/benchmark_round1/benchmark_round1_metrics.csv        (execution output — not created in design task)
